magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
magic_missile.description: Two missiles at caster level 3, each 1d4+1, no save, no attack roll. PHB p.227: one missile at 1st level plus one per two levels beyond 1st (max 5).

mage_armor.name: Mage Armor
mage_armor.description: +4 armor bonus to AC, 1 hour/level (PHB p.225). Range touch; armor bonuses do not stack with worn armor.

scorching_ray.name: Scorching Ray
scorching_ray.description: Ranged touch attack, 4d6 fire damage at caster level 3 (PHB p.274). One ray at this level.

cure_light_wounds.name: Cure Light Wounds
cure_light_wounds.description: Heals 1d8 + caster level (max +5) hit points; also stabilizes a dying creature (PHB p.215).

bless.name: Bless
bless.description: +1 morale bonus on attack rolls and on saves against fear for 1 min./level (PHB p.205). This slice has no fear effects; attack bonus is applied.

aid.name: Aid
aid.description: +1 morale bonus on attack rolls and saves against fear, plus 1d8 + caster level temporary hit points (max +10) for 1 min./level (PHB p.196). Temporary hit points do not stack.
